_note: Furniture for the player's homes (systems/furnishing.js, world/innerMap/furnishing.js). Each piece draws with an interior furniture type (its art in innerMapRenderer.json → interiorArt.furniture, its glyph in ui/icons.js) and does what that type does (ui/objectActions/data.js FURNITURE_ACTIONS: a bed sleeps, a chest stores, a hearth cooks). footprint [w, h] in tiles; a piece longer one way turns (R) to lie the other. minSettlement: the smallest place whose furniture maker makes it. comfort: added to the comfort need each hour spent in a home it stands in (all pieces together capped at comfortCap). restBonus: a bed's sleep restores this much more (0.2 = +20%).

items.name: Straw Pallet
items.desc: Ticking stuffed with straw. Better than the floor.

items.name: Plank Bed
items.desc: A sturdy frame, a wool blanket. You sleep a little better.

items.name: Featherbed
items.desc: Goose down on a carved frame. Sleep restores a quarter more.

items.name: Canopy Bed
items.desc: Curtained, broad and deep. The bed of a lord.

items.name: Storage Chest
items.desc: Store your goods at home: put in and take out as you please.

items.name: Iron-bound Strongbox
items.desc: Oak bound in iron, with a stout lock. Storage.

items.name: Crate
items.desc: Rough boards nailed together. Storage.

items.name: Water Barrel
items.desc: Fresh water to drink, and room for stores.

items.name: Bookshelf
items.desc: Read in an idle hour; keep things on its shelves.

items.name: Plain Table
items.desc: Sit, eat, play a game of dice.

items.name: Long Table

items.name: Bench

items.name: Rag Rug

items.name: Woven Carpet
